documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for For Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company Along With The Limited Review Report For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by strategic capacity expansions including the commercialization of its new Alu-Zinc coating line and the augmentation of existing colour-coated capacities. Consolidated revenues crossed the ₹1,000 Crore milestone for the first time, reaching ₹1,053.19 Crore, while EBITDA almost tripled and profit after tax showed significant growth. The company maintained a conservative debt-equity ratio with no long-term debt raised for its capital expenditure programmes. Management outlined further expansion plans, targeting consolidated revenues of ₹1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and ₹3,000 Crore by FY 2028-29. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its annual performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore, EBITDA of H25.69 Crore, and profit after tax of H11.70 Crore.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the colour coating manufacturing line expansion is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: Management expects the colour coating manufacturing line expansion to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
guidance.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the second expansion programme comprises a H40 Crore investment in a new colour coating manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the second expansion programme will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote:
As on March 31 FY 23 FY 24 FY 25
EBITDA margin % 3.79 7.61 4.40

margins_costs.claim: The company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, which is the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Hot dipped galvanized steel contributed 39.75% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company specialises in manufacturing hot-dipped galvanized steel for the building materials, white goods and electronic appliance industries, contributing 39.75% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-painted profile sheets contributed 41.88% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: This segment contributed 41.88% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: Cold-rolled steel sheets and coils contributed 16.06% to the company's manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: Widely used in industries like automobiles, home appliances, hot-dipped galvanized steel and pre-painted steel products, they contributed 16.06% to the Company’s manufacturing-derived turnover in FY 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economic environment remains fragile and has led to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that a decline in sales growth on both standalone and consolidated levels failed to offset challenges posed by global market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the new colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to introduce a new Alu-Zinc product during the year.
management_commitments.quote: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
